data.title: PSG make major announcement about two starters ahead of Ligue 1 fixture this weekend - Yahoo Sports
data.content: ***PSG are taking advantage of their squad by leaving allowing some key players to rest after the international break.***. PSG have taken a different approach with two of their players. They've decided to give Nuno Mendes and Ousmane Dembele the weekend off after busy periods of international football with Portugal and France respectively. Neither will be in the squad to face Le Mans this weekend – we've seen similar things already this season, with many of their stars integrated slowly into the season after a busy World Cup summer. It's worked wonders in keeping the team fresh and making sure they peak both physically and mentally at the crucial moment of the season, at the sharp end of the Champions League knock out stages. The rest of the Champions League have their work cut out for them already. An 18 year old starlet is being targeted by PSG as they try to continue building their squad for the future.

data.title: Le Mans’ Adil Bourabaa sustains injury - Yahoo Sports
data.content: * Valkyries, Dream win Game 2s. # Le Mans’ Adil Bourabaa sustains injury. Adil Bourabaa (21) has enjoyed an explosive start to the season, culminating in a maiden call-up to the Algeria national team, however, he now looks set for a period on the sidelines, as per a report from **Foot Mercato****.**. The Algerian already has three goals in Ligue 1, as well as two assists. He has helped his club, Le Mans FC, defy expectations in the opening weeks of the season. Patrick Videira's side were heavily tipped for relegation, but currently sit ninth. Bourabaa is a big reason why, however, while away with the Algeria national team, he sustained an ankle injury. It is a blow that will rule him out of this Saturday's game against Paris Saint-Germain. The midfielder will undergo further tests on the injury today in order to ascertain his period of absence. The expectation, however, is that that the former ESTAC Troyes midfielder will miss several weeks of competition.
